scientific_boundary: The V9 flat event-argument shape cannot distinguish a direct classification argument from a participant-to-participant locus restriction, and it cannot represent that a classification applies to an explicit majority subset rather than the entire antecedent cohort.

participant_scope_link.purpose: Represent an occurrence-bound participant-set restriction without inventing an event or direct event argument.

partitive_scope.purpose: Represent the explicit partitive applicability of the existing event argument without a new participant or event.

explicit_non_changes: V9 through V15 schemas, evaluators, artifacts, and results
required_evaluator_behavior: Require the normal affected-entity link, one correctly grounded scope link, and one correctly grounded majority qualifier for the uncertainty source lane.
Allow zero or one independently source-supported direct contextual locus edge only after the required scope link passes.
Do not accept a direct contextual edge, exact evidence, or a locus node alone as a substitute for scope.
Resolve character spans deterministically from source evidence and participant text; do not ask the provider to emit offsets.
Keep the V14 independently lexicalized identifier rule unchanged.
